oracle.name: Power Pages
oracle.scope: Two signed-in loads on 2026-11-26 (runs d1, d2) of a list of an Enhanced-data-model site hosting an invented dataset probe as its table's grid control (page size 3, the exported view and grid control configuration, seeded invented rows), while the table permission rows of the list's table and its child table (global, granted to Authenticated Users) had read set to false: the status and JSON body of the grid data request the control sent. Establishes the grid service answer without read permission; not the data set state or client behaviour.
